title: Happy goldfish
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id="bodyGrad" cx="50%" cy="45%" r="50%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FFB347"/>
      <stop offset="70%" stop-color="#FF8C00"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#E07000"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id="tailGrad" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FFAA44"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FF6600"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id="finGrad" cx="50%" cy="30%" r="60%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FFBB55"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FF7700"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id="bubbleGrad" cx="40%" cy="35%" r="50%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#88EEFF"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#33BBEE"/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Bubbles -->
  <circle cx="78" cy="18" r="4" fill="url(#bubbleGrad)" opacity="0.85"/>
  <circle cx="84" cy="10" r="3" fill="url(#bubbleGrad)" opacity="0.7"/>
  <circle cx="73" cy="26" r="2.5" fill="url(#bubbleGrad)" opacity="0.6"/>

  <!-- Tail -->
  <path d="M68 52 Q88 38 86 52 Q88 66 68 52 Z" fill="url(#tailGrad)"/>
  <path d="M68 52 Q82 46 82 52 Q82 58 68 52 Z" fill="#FFCC66" opacity="0.7"/>

  <!-- Dorsal fin -->
  <path d="M38 30 Q50 18 60 28 Q55 26 50 32 Q45 27 38 30 Z" fill="url(#finGrad)"/>

  <!-- Ventral fin -->
  <path d="M40 72 Q45 84 52 74 Z" fill="url(#finGrad)"/>

  <!-- Pectoral fin -->
  <path d="M48 60 Q55 72 42 68 Z" fill="url(#finGrad)" opacity="0.85"/>

  <!-- Body -->
  <ellipse cx="48" cy="51" rx="26" ry="20" fill="url(#bodyGrad)"/>

  <!-- Body highlight -->
  <ellipse cx="44" cy="44" rx="12" ry="8" fill="#FFD48A" opacity="0.45"/>

  <!-- Scales suggestion -->
  <path d="M36 48 Q40 44 44 48" stroke="#FFB055" stroke-width="1" fill="none" opacity="0.5"/>
  <path d="M44 48 Q48 44 52 48" stroke="#FFB055" stroke-width="1" fill="none" opacity="0.5"/>
  <path d="M40 54 Q44 50 48 54" stroke="#FFB055" stroke-width="1" fill="none" opacity="0.5"/>
  <path d="M48 54 Q52 50 56 54" stroke="#FFB055" stroke-width="1" fill="none" opacity="0.5"/>

  <!-- Eye white -->
  <circle cx="34" cy="46" r="6" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <!-- Iris -->
  <circle cx="33" cy="46" r="3.5" fill="#1A1A5E"/>
  <!-- Pupil -->
  <circle cx="33" cy="46" r="2" fill="#000033"/>
  <!-- Eye shine -->
  <circle cx="34.5" cy="44.5" r="1.2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Cheek blush -->
  <ellipse cx="30" cy="56" rx="4" ry="2.5" fill="#FF6688" opacity="0.55"/>

  <!-- Happy mouth -->
  <path d="M30 58 Q34 63 39 58" stroke="#CC4400" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Lip / front mouth shape -->
  <ellipse cx="28" cy="54" rx="3" ry="2.5" fill="#FFB070" opacity="0.6"/>
</svg>
